test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence from the options given.

options.text: An troll, the boy shared on the social media created the big laughter.
The troll, the boy shared on social media created a big laughter.
A troll, a boy shared in on social media created an big laughter.
The troll, a boy shared on an social media created a big laughter.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. The troll, the boy shared on social media created a big laughter.
